text.tspan: Projections of the fertility rate by education scenario World, 1955 to 2100
The total fertility rate summarizes the total number of births a woman would have, if she experienced the birth
rates seen in women of each age group in one particular year across her childbearing years. This shows

tspan.tspan: In the original data the fertility rate refer to 5 year windows. For limitations of the visualisation tool, the last-year for each window is

text.tspan: shown here instead. (For example 1975 here refers to the period 1970-1975 in the original data.).
